mainLetter:
Dear you,

I don’t know if words will ever be enough to explain what you mean to me.

But I’ll keep trying anyway.

You make ordinary moments feel special. You make difficult days feel a little lighter. And somehow, just knowing you’re there makes everything feel a little more okay.

If I could choose one person to keep discovering life with…

I’d choose you.

Again.
And again.
And again.

— {author} ♡
openWhen: A letter for every kind of day.
letterTitles: When you wonder if you’re loved
letterBodies: Come here. You don’t have to pretend you’re okay. Let the day be heavy for a moment. I’ll sit beside you through it.
Look at the sky for a moment. We’re under the same one. Until I can hold your hand again, let this little letter hold a piece of you.
Unclench your jaw. Let your shoulders fall. Nothing needs to be solved tonight. You are safe to rest, and tomorrow can wait.
You’re allowed to feel it. Take all the space you need. I want to understand you, even when the words come out tangled.
You’ve already made it through things you thought you couldn’t. I see your courage in the way you keep showing up. Borrow my belief in you today.
One difficult day doesn’t make a difficult life. Let’s make the next small thing gentle: a glass of water, a deep breath, a little kindness to yourself.
Somewhere, someone is smiling at their phone because of you. It’s me. I’m someone. And yes, I’m doing it again.
You are loved in the loud moments and the quiet ones. On your brilliant days and your messy days. You don’t need to earn it. You already have it.
